delivery.title: Delivery report

delivery.noCallback: No delivery webhook is set for this project, so only the status changes. Set one in the setup.

scenario.title: Force a failure
scenario.description: The next request this project makes to a provider fails the way the provider fails, then the switch resets. Sending to a magic number fails that one request too.
scenario.armed: Armed for {{project}}: the next request fails

setup.title: Point an app at the catcher
setup.intro: One catcher serves every project. The project is the SMTP username and the first path segment, so each app only changes its host and a name.
setup.projectHint: Choose or type a name; a new one exists as soon as an app uses it.
setup.hostHint: A Docksal container reaches this machine as host.docker.internal; something running on the Mac itself uses localhost.
setup.mailHint: Any password works. Without a login the project is default.
setup.providersHint: Only the base URL changes. Keep the real key out of it: the catcher checks that a key is there and never what it is.
setup.apiHint: For integration tests: list, assert on and clear what the project sent. The routes match msgpit's.
setup.webhookHint: Where the catcher calls back when you mark an SMS delivered or failed.
setup.webhookReachable: Called from this machine, so a Docksal site is reachable as its http://*.docksal.site address.
setup.notRunning: The catcher is not listening, so nothing sends to it yet. See Settings, Messages.
setup.magicHint: Send an SMS to one of these and the request fails instead of being stored.

settings.title: Messages
settings.description: The local catcher for the mail, SMS and push your apps send while you develop.
settings.enabledDescription: Listens while the app runs. Turn it off to free both ports.
settings.smtpPortDescription: Mail from the apps arrives here.
settings.httpPortDescription: The provider APIs and the test API listen here.
settings.spamdDescription: host:port of a spamd. Every new mail gets a score when it is set.
settings.notifyDescription: A desktop notification when the app is in the background, and a toast when it is not. A burst counts as one.
settings.portInvalid: A port is a number from 1 to 65535.
